# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old in Volume 1, reaching around eighty-five by Volume 5  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farm manager  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza has a tall, slender frame with sharp angles rather than curves, and dark hair with graying strands bound tightly in a bun pierced by wire hairpins. She has a sallow, stern face with a mouth that hints at a humorous disposition, and her hair turns snow-white in her later years.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v2 c23 P18](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0018)_

## Personality

Thirza is an unyielding, practical woman with a stern demeanor and a strict sense of morality. Though she appears sharp and abrupt, she possesses an underlying sense of humor, deep compassion, and a quiet capacity for intense affection. She is intensely proud, determined, and stubborn, often preferring to hide her tender emotions behind strictness or sarcasm.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v2 c30 P3](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0003)_

## Traits

- Practical and orderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c11 P10](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0010)</sub>
- Strict moral sense  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c7 P6](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0006)</sub>
- Stubborn and determined  <sub>[v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)</sub>
- Fear of emotional vulnerability  <sub>[v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v2 c30 P3](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0003)</sub>

## Abilities

- Expert homemaker and cook  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c21 P12](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0012)</sub>
- Currant wine production  <sub>[v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046)</sub>

## Goals

- Raise Nell to be a proper, practical, and well-behaved young woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 c12 P6](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0006)</sub>
- Maintain the Grey Shutters farmstead and family legacy  <sub>[v2 c2 P38](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0038)</sub>

## History

Thirza Abernethy resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her timid brother, Obed. Expecting an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist on the farm, she is shocked when Obed returns with a red-haired orphan girl, Nell Harcourt. Although Thirza initially intends to return Nell or pass her to a neighbor, she relents out of compassion and agrees to raise her. Over the years, Thirza strictly disciplines Nell while secretly developing a fierce maternal affection for her. When Obed dies suddenly after losing his savings in a bank failure, Thirza intends to sell Grey Shutters, but Nell gives up her college scholarship to stay and support her. Later, Thirza develops eye trouble and faces complete blindness unless she refrains from reading and sewing; Nell again makes sacrifices to care for her until Mrs. Agatha Sowerby moves into Grey Shutters to live with Thirza, enabling Nell to attend Wexcombe College. Years later, Thirza takes in the orphaned Farrow twins, Robin and Lucy, raising them alongside Nell, and eventually sees Nell marry Hugh Carrow, the son of her own youthful romance.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P21](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0021), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Brierley with her quiet brother, Obed Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Had a youthful romance with John Carrow that ended after a quarrel she refused to forgive  <sub>[v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Inherited an exquisite amethyst brooch from her mother  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>

## Quotes

> An orphan girl is not what I want, and even if she were, I would not choose her type.  <sub>[v1 c3 P63](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0063)</sub>

> I refuse to hold with picturing things other than how they actually exist.  <sub>[v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019)</sub>

> Agatha, it was wrong of you to mock her appearance.  <sub>[v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026)</sub>

> My love for you is as deep as though you were my very own child, and from the moment you arrived at Grey Shutters, you have brought me nothing but happiness and solace.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
